versions.name: Camp Wakpominee
versions.address: 185 Sly Pond Rd Fort Ann, New York 12827

features.note: Range and target activities; the camp supplies all shooting equipment.
Bait is provided by the camp.
Gelder Dining Hall, with family-style service.
Two shower houses with individual lockable stalls.
Two-person canvas wall tents on wooden platforms.
Provisional campers are placed with a selected troop for the week.
A week-long wilderness canoe trek in the Adirondacks.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/364-Wakpominee2026); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
